NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️ | Failing tests: there were 2 new pushes and the author says they're fixed, but CI status isn't visible, so please check it before handing off |
| ⚠️ | Self-review checklist: several testing boxes are still unchecked (strings and tooltips, end-to-end button behavior, corner cases) |
| ℹ️ | The "not ready" label came with no written feedback, so the failing tests are the only request we can identify |
| ℹ️ | In the CZO design thread, Karl Stolley suggested flexbox/grid with the icon and text as separate DOM elements. It isn't clear from the input whether this PR does that. |
| ℹ️ | Issue #38844 is "help wanted" and assigned to this author. Another PR for it, #39694, is still open. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" until CI is confirmed green and the checklist is completed; no labels or assignee change yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Could you confirm that CI is passing now, and finish the testing items in the self-review checklist (see the [reviewable PRs guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html))? Also take a look at Karl's layout suggestion in the [#design thread](https://chat.zulip.org/#narrow/channel/101-design/topic/Style.20of.20.22show.20more.22.2F.22show.20less.22.20buttons.20on.20long.20messages).
```
